data: Which of the following blocks is connected to C-DSR Engine with a double arrow?

The question asks which block is connected to the C-DSR Engine with a double arrow. From the analysis of the figure, we can see that there are two types of arrows used in the diagram: single arrows and double arrows. Double arrows indicate bidirectional communication or interaction.

Looking at the connections involving the C-DSR Engine, we observe that there is a double arrow connecting the Parser block to the C-DSR Engine. This indicates a bidirectional communication between these two components.

Therefore, the block connected to the C-DSR Engine with a double arrow is the Parser block.
